text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

Both you and the successful candidate are women, so sex was almost certainly not a factor in the outcome. An all-female panel selecting one woman over another provides no viable evidence of sex discrimination. Pointing out the panel's gender composition will appear baseless, harm your professional reputation, and alienate key peers in municipal governance.

The municipality likely prioritized extensive public engagement experience over technical credentials, which is common for leadership roles facing contentious community issues. Follow up politely regarding your feedback request, framing it strictly around your professional development and understanding the municipality’s current strategic priorities, rather than questioning the panel's demographics.
